points: Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ¼ tsp salt on high heat. Add the rice and cook for 10-12 mins.
Drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Get Started

points: Meanwhile, halve the green pepper and discard the core and seeds. Slice into thin strips, then chop into roughly 1cm pieces.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the pork mince, Central American style spice mix and sliced pepper. Fry until the mince has browned, 5-6 mins. Use a spoon to break up the mince as it cooks.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince

steps.title: Get Frying

points: While the mince cooks, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Once the mince has browned, drain and discard any excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.

notes.text: The mince is cooked when no longer pink in the middle

steps.title: Finish the Prep

points: Add the garlic to the mince and cook for 1 min more.
Stir through the passata, chicken stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts).
Simmer until the sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 mins.
steps.title: Stew Time

points: Stir the BBQ sauce through the mince and cook until thickened and warmed through, 1-2 mins.
Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. Add a splash of water if it's a little too thick.
Fluff up the rice with a fork.
steps.title: Flavour Town

points: When everything's ready, share the rice between your serving bowls.
Scatter over the cheese and dollop on the smashed avocado to finish.
steps.title: Serve Up
